name: Stations
tip: XPRS stations you own, and freshly flashed ones nearby waiting for an owner.

children.name: stations
children.empty:
No station here yet.

Flash one from xprs.dev/firmware and keep this phone close: a new station asks to be claimed over Bluetooth within a quarter of a minute, and shows up here.

A board without Bluetooth: join its WiFi hotspot, XPRS- and its callsign, and it shows up the same way.

name: Station
tip: Claim it, put it on your network, name it, and see how it is doing.

children.name: detail
children.empty: Pick a station on the Stations screen.

children.name: claim
children.label: Claim it
children.tip: Make it yours. The first owner to answer a freshly flashed station owns it.

children.name: wifi_pass
children.label: WiFi password
children.tip: Sealed to the station's own key before it leaves this phone, and kept nowhere on it. Leave empty for an open network.

children.name: zone
children.label: Time zone
children.hint: auto, or an offset such as +01:00
children.tip: auto asks a time service once the station is online.

children.name: identity
children.label: Its identity
children.tip: A station's callsign comes from its key. A new key is a new callsign; an imported one lets a replacement carry on under an old callsign.

children.name: nsec
children.label: nsec to import
children.tip: Only for Take a key I have. Sealed to the station and kept nowhere on this phone.

children.name: identity_apply
children.label: Apply identity
children.confirm-text: A new key gives the station a new callsign. It restarts, and anyone who knew it by its old callsign has to learn the new one.

children.name: log
children.label: What happened
children.tip: Every answer the station gave, newest last.
